declarations.description:
An answer where learners mark the words of a text that fit the question.

The text must be assigned to the default slot; the element itself must be
assigned to the default slot of a `<webwriter-task>`.
declarations.name: WebWriterMark

members.name: highlights
members.default: { marked: new Highlight(), correct: new Highlight(), missed: new Highlight(), wrong: new Highlight(), }

members.name: gradingMethod
members.description:
How the score of this answer is calculated.

- `pass-fail`: Full score only if exactly the correct words are marked.
- `partial`: Correctly marked words earn credit, wrong ones subtract from it.

members.name: solution
members.description: The indices of the word-like segments counting as correct. It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

declarations.description:
The question text of a `<webwriter-task>`.

It must be assigned to the `prompt` slot of its parent element. An optional
`<webwriter-quiz-hint>` may be assigned to its `hint` slot.
declarations.name: WebwriterTaskPrompt

declarations.description:
A task describes a single quiz question, which consists of a
`<webwriter-task-prompt>`, an optional `<webwriter-quiz-hint>` and an answer
of a certain type, such as `<webwriter-choice>`.

The `<webwriter-task-prompt>` must be assigned to the `prompt` slot, the
`<webwriter-quiz-hint>` must be assigned to the `hint` slot and the answer
must be assigned to the default slot.
declarations.name: WebwriterTask

declarations.description:
An answer where learners type a value into an input field.

It must be assigned to the default slot of a `<webwriter-task>`.
declarations.name: WebwriterText

members.name: type
members.description:
The kind of input field learners answer in.

- `long-text`: A multi-line text area.
- `text`: A single-line text field.
- `number`: A number field.
- `date`: A date picker.
- `time`: A time picker.
- `datetime-local`: A combined date and time picker.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: The placeholder shown while the field is empty.

members.name: freeText
members.description: Whether any non-empty answer counts as correct, without comparing it to the solution.

members.name: ignoreCase
members.description: Whether the answer is compared to the solution case-insensitively.

members.name: correctMessage
members.description: The feedback shown after submitting if the answer is correct.

members.name: wrongMessage
members.description: The feedback shown after submitting if the answer is wrong.

members.name: solution
members.description: The value counting as correct. It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

declarations.description:
An answer where learners pick one or more options.

The options must be `<webwriter-choice-item>` elements assigned to the
default slot.
declarations.name: WebwriterChoice

members.name: mode
members.description:
How many options learners may select.

- `single`: Exactly one option can be selected.
- `multiple`: Any number of options can be selected.

members.name: layout
members.description:
How the options are arranged.

- `list`: One option per row.
- `tiles`: A responsive grid of equally sized tiles.

members.name: randomizeOrder
members.description:
If true, the order of options will be randomized for learners.

Note: Randomization occurs only during the first render, so changing this property dynamically will not have any effect.

members.name: gradingMethod
members.description:
How the score of this answer is calculated.

- `pass-fail`: Full score only if exactly the correct options are selected.
- `partial`: Correct selections earn credit, wrong ones subtract from it.

members.name: solution
members.description:
The options counting as correct, as a map from option ID to whether it has to be selected.
It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

members.description: The placeholder shown while the gap is empty. Only applies in `input` mode.

attributes.name: placeholder

declarations.description:
An answer where learners fill the gaps in a text.

The text must be assigned to the default slot, with a `<webwriter-gap-item>`
in place of each gap.
declarations.name: WebwriterGap

members.name: mode
members.description:
How learners fill the gaps.

- `input`: Each gap is a text field learners type into.
- `drag-and-drop`: The gaps are filled from a shared pool of draggable answers.

members.name: ignoreCase
members.description: Whether answers are compared to the solution case-insensitively. Only applies in `input` mode.

members.name: place
members.description: Moves `choice` into the gap `target`, or back into the tray of choices for `null`.

members.name: targetAt
members.description:
The gap under the given point, if it belongs to this element. The ghost does not take
pointer events, so it never hides the gap underneath it.

type.text: ({ left: string } & ({ top: string } | { bottom: string })) | null

events.name: change
events.description: Dispatched when learners move an answer into or out of a gap. Only in `drag-and-drop` mode.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description:
How learners fill the gaps.

- `input`: Each gap is a text field learners type into.
- `drag-and-drop`: The gaps are filled from a shared pool of draggable answers.

attributes.name: ignore-case
attributes.description: Whether answers are compared to the solution case-insensitively. Only applies in `input` mode.

declarations.description:
A single item of a `<webwriter-order>`.

It must be assigned to the default slot of its parent element. An optional
`<webwriter-quiz-hint>` may be assigned to its `hint` slot.
declarations.name: WebwriterOrderItem

declarations.description:
An answer where learners drag items into the correct order.

The items must be `<webwriter-order-item>` elements assigned to the default
slot.
declarations.name: WebwriterOrder

members.name: layout
members.description:
How the items are arranged.

- `list`: One item per row.
- `tiles`: A responsive grid of equally sized tiles.

members.name: direction
members.description:
The direction in which the items are numbered.

- `ascending`: The first item carries the lowest position.
- `descending`: The first item carries the highest position.

members.name: numberingStyle
members.description:
How the position of each item is labelled.

- `none`: No position is shown.
- `numeric`: Arabic numerals (1., 2., 3., ...).
- `alphabetic`: Latin letters (A., B., C., ...).
- `roman`: Roman numerals (I., II., III., ...).

members.name: gradingMethod
members.description:
How the score of this answer is calculated.

- `pass-fail`: Full score only if every item is in its correct position.
- `partial-position`: Credit for each item in its correct position.
- `partial-sequence`: Credit for each pair of adjacent items in the correct order.

members.name: solution
members.description: The IDs of the items in their correct order. It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

declarations.description:
An answer where learners match items into pairs.

The items must be `<webwriter-pairing-item>` children of this element.
declarations.name: WebwriterPairing

members.name: mode
members.description:
How learners match the items.

- `pairing`: All items are visible and learners drag them together.
- `memory`: The items are face down and learners uncover two at a time.

members.name: solution
members.description: The pairs counting as correct, as tuples of the two item IDs. It is obfuscated in the markup so that learners cannot read it directly.

members.name: pairIndex
members.description: Index of the pair an item belongs to, or -1 if it belongs to none.
